selection:
    - Description: 'Windows PowerShell'
    - Product: 'PowerShell Core 6'
filter:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'bxor'
        - '-join '
        - '-join'''
        - '-join"'
        - '-join`'
        - 'char'

    ParentImage: 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\SSM\ssm-document-worker.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'function Convert-GuidToCompressedGuid'
condition: selection and filter and not false_positives

selection_metadata:
    - Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    - Description: 'Windows PowerShell'
    - Product: 'PowerShell Core 6'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'bxor'
        - '-join '
        - '-join'''
        - '-join"'
        - '-join`'
        - 'char'
filter_amazon:
    ParentImage: 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\SSM\ssm-document-worker.exe'
filter_powershell_script:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        # Example: https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/pull/3717#issue-1455440560
        - 'function Convert-GuidToCompressedGuid'
        - 'ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*

selection_metadata:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
    - Description: 'Windows PowerShell'
    - Product: 'PowerShell Core 6'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'bxor'
        - '-join '
        - '-join'''
        - '-join"'
        - '-join`'
        - 'char'
filter_amazon:
    ParentImage: 'C:\Program Files\Amazon\SSM\ssm-document-worker.exe'
filter_powershell_script:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        # Script part of Amazon SSM worker (But the parent is empty - see example linked below)
        # Example: https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/pull/3717#issue-1455440560
        - 'function Convert-GuidToCompressedGuid'
        - 'ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName'
        - '::ParseExact('
        - 'KB[000000-999999]'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
